title.en: PostgreSQL Optimization for 10M+ Row Tables Under Flash-Sale Concurrency
title.id: Optimasi PostgreSQL untuk Tabel 10 Juta Baris pada Beban Konkurensi Flash-Sale
title.zh: 应对千万级数据量与秒杀并发压力的PostgreSQL深度优化实践
title.ja: フラッシュセールの高同時アクセスに対応する1000万行規模のPostgreSQL最適化
title.ko: 플래시 세일 동시성 트래픽을 견디는 1,000만 행 규모의 PostgreSQL 성능 튜닝

desc.en: From table bloat to index bloat: how partition strategies and advisory locks kept our database under 15% CPU during high-traffic events.
desc.id: Dari table bloat hingga index bloat: strategi partisi dan advisory lock menjaga utilisasi CPU database di bawah 15% saat traffic memuncak.
desc.zh: 通过表分区策略和咨询锁（Advisory Locks），在流量高峰期将数据库CPU占用率稳定在15%以下。
desc.ja: テーブルパーティショニングとアドバイザリーロックを活用し、トラフィック急増時でもCPU負荷を15%以下に抑えた方法。
desc.ko: 테이블 파티셔닝 전략과 자문 락(Advisory Lock)을 통해 대규모 트래픽 발생 시에도 CPU 사용률을 15% 미만으로 유지한 기법.

body.en:
From table bloat to index bloat: how partition strategies and advisory locks kept our database under 15% CPU during high-traffic events.

The Danger of High-Concurrency Row Locking

During flash-sale promotional events, hundreds of concurrent checkout requests fight over inventory rows using SELECT FOR UPDATE. This triggers database lock waits, cascading query timeouts, and runaway connection exhaustion.

10xexecution speed acceleration
94%reduction in manual data entry errors
sub-50msend-to-end processing latency

Replacing Row Locks with Application Advisory Locks

By shifting mutual exclusion to PostgreSQL advisory locks keyed on product ID hashes, or handling atomic decrements via Redis Lua scripts, the primary database handles thousands of transactions per second without deadlock contention.

Declarative Partitioning and BRIN Indexes

For ledger and audit tables exceeding 10 million rows, standard B-tree indexes consume gigabytes of memory cache. Partitioning tables by calendar month and utilizing BRIN (Block Range Index) for append-only logs reduced index footprint by 88%.

Enterprise Automation Worker Pipeline
from celery import Celery
import redis

celery_app = Celery("enterprise_automation", broker="redis://127.0.0.1:6379/0")

@celery_app.task(bind=True, max_retries=3, default_retry_delay=60)
def process_data_pipeline_job(self, task_payload: dict):
    try:
        validated_data = validate_enterprise_schema(task_payload)
        sync_to_database(validated_data)
        return {"success": True, "count": len(validated_data)}
    except Exception as exc:
        raise self.retry(exc=exc)

Tuning Autovacuum and Memory Buffers

Default PostgreSQL autovacuum settings are too conservative for write-heavy e-commerce workloads. Tuning autovacuum_vacuum_cost_limit and shared_buffers eliminated table bloat and preserved index lookups in sub-5ms latency.
